name: implement
deprecation_criterion: Superseded when the model-backed implement-then-PR doer (DESIGN §3.6.2/§3.6.3) replaces the dry-run reference adapter, or when the Handoff schema reaches a breaking major version.
spec_change_reason: v0.12.0: Handoff schema 1.1.0 -> 1.2.0 (additive) adds `already_done` to the status value space — a TERMINAL already-satisfied outcome the doer emits when the requested change is already present on `main`, with evidence in artifact {kind:already-on-main, ref:<commit-sha>}. It is DISTINCT from the retryable `blocked`: scheduling records an already_done item resolved (not re-dispatched), whereas blocked is re-dispatched. `already_done` opens NO PR and (this wave) leaves the source issue OPEN. HANDOFF_SCHEMA_VERSION bumped to 1.2.0; validate_handoff docstring names already_done as a non-opened handoff valid without a test_verdict (no logic change — the predicate already treats every non-opened status as verdict-free). Shipped implementer agent .md v2.11.0 -> v2.12.0 instructs the doer to report already_done (NOT blocked) with the already-on-main commit evidence when the fix is already on main. Housekeep doc baseline re-anchored spec.md 386 -> 421; already_done + already-on-main added to load-bearing token set. NOTE: the spec prose labeled the change 'v2.10.0' but the agent file was already at v2.11.0; bumped forward to v2.12.0 (monotonic) and reconciled the two spec prose refs. spec.md was authored/committed by the dispatcher spec-update phase. PRIOR v0.11.1: open_pr.py setup_worktree now runs the worktree add HOOKS-FREE via `git -c core.hooksPath=/dev/null worktree add ...` so the target repo's post-checkout hook (e.g. ssbdci-grimlock's render_nested_components) never fires in the implementer's disposable worktree — mirrors verify-integrate's reconcile/GATE hooks-off fix. All other setup_worktree behavior unchanged (resolve default branch, git fetch origin <default>, start-point origin/<default> never local HEAD, gh pr create --base <default>). PRIOR v0.11.0: moved the shipped implementer's worktree-setup + PR-open from PROMPT-TIER git/gh prose into a DETERMINISTIC companion script src/open_pr.py (spec-rules §4 Script-Backed Orchestration), fixing the live wrong-base STACKED PR bug (#844 based on #831's branch, #846 on #844's) that a back-to-back drain burst produced. The script UNCONDITIONALLY resolves the repo default branch (gh repo view --json defaultBranchRef), git fetch origin <default>, git worktree add <wt> -b <branch> origin/<default> (start-point ALWAYS the fresh remote ref, NEVER local HEAD), and gh pr create --base <default> (explicit base, never inferred/tracked); it has an injectable runner for deterministic tests. Rewrote the agent .md (v2.10.0->v2.11.0) to INVOKE the script at ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/lib/open_pr.py (deployed convention, like test_gate.py) in place of the raw git/gh base prose; own-worktree isolation + all other steps (test_gate, self-review, supersede, regen, Closes #<n>) preserved. contract.md 0.7.0->0.8.0 adds open_pr.py to provides.scripts + invokes. Housekeep doc baseline re-anchored in-scope (spec.md 355->378, contract.md 35->36). NOTE follow-on: packaging-config build_plugin _LIBS must register lib/open_pr.py (mirroring test_gate.py) so it deploys — a separate packaging release, out of this feature's scope. spec.md was authored/committed by the dispatcher spec-update phase.
spec_no_change_reason: spec.md already advanced to 0.12.0 (already_done terminal status, schema 1.2.0) by the dispatcher spec-update phase; this cycle implements that spec change in src + agent .md
